reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: I don’t leave negative reviews but this one is not only deserved but needed. Euchre is supposed to be a fun game, this game is indeed rigged, which ruins the whole experience. Any games after the 1000 tokens buy in, you will notice that you never get a good hand. Never a hand good enough to call Trump while your opponents will constantly call it. What makes it more obvious is that the player who calls it won’t have anything and their teammate will somehow have a monster hand, yet the other one called it. It’s definitely not live player and you’re playing with computer. So yeah, just be forewarned about this game before downloading. The higher the tokens, somehow you get worse hands. It’s almost like they want you to lose your tokens so you buy more instead of letting you play a fair game. Integrity is out the door on this one.
